<title level="1" pfs="">[Hexworm](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3289)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

These gray larvae inch across the ground with an instinct to feed on magic.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 19

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 17

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 14
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 4">[Hexworm](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3289)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Tiny" />
<trait label="Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=531" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 159

**Perception** +10; arcanosense ([precise](/Rules.aspx?ID=411)) 60 feet

**Languages**

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) +10, [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35) +12, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) +9

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +2

**Dex** +4

**Con** +3

**Int** -5

**Wis** +1

**Cha** +0
</row>

**Arcanosense** A hexworm can sense sources of magic at the listed range as though it has a 4th-rank [_detect magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1485) constant innate spell.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 20 

**Fort** +11 

**Ref** +14 

**Will** +6 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 45

</row>

**Resistances**
arcanovore

**Arcanovore** A hexworm has resistance 5 against all damage caused by spells.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
mandibles +8,
**Damage** 2d6+2 piercing plus Arcane Consumption

**Arcane Consumption** <actions string="Single Action" />  The hexworm attempts to consume the magic of an adjacent magical effect or unattended magic item. It attempts a [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) check against the target with a +11 modifier. On a success, the magical effect ends. A magic item instead becomes a mundane item for 1 round. The hexworm gains 2d8 Hit Points.

**Arcanotaxis** <actions string="Free Action" />  **Requirements** The hexworm has detected a source of magic with its arcanosense; **Trigger** The hexworm's turn begins; **Effect** The hexworm Strides up to its Speed toward the nearest source of magic it can detect.

</column>
